subject: QBR Prep — runway maps, forecast consolidation & account playbooks
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR Prep — runway maps, forecast consolidation & account playbooks

Team —

We need a tight QBR package for the board readout and the GTM leadership meeting. I’ve attached a starter workbook (runway-maps_v1.xlsx) with three tabs: per-account one-pagers, consolidated forecast, and playbook checklist. Please take the sections below and add your inputs by EOD Wednesday (2027-08-14).

Ask (per account):
- One-line summary (what we sell them / why now)
- ARR/ACV in the deal.
- Current close date (HubSpot deal id included in the workbook).
- Confidence % (low/med/high and a numeric guidance).
- Top 2 blockers and required action (SOC/compliance, procurement, technical POC).
- Recommended playbook for next 30 days (owner + 3 steps).

Priority accounts in the workbook: Stratus Retail (Sentinel cohort), NimblePay, and Sentinel Health. If you can’t fill all accounts, prioritize Stratus and NimblePay. I’ll consolidate and produce the final runway map for the board.

External follow-ups: I’ll coordinate a short alignment call with the Stratus buyer (Jamie Lee) after we lock the playbook. Please flag any asks that require legal/procurement involvement.

Attachments: runway-maps_v1.xlsx

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR Prep — runway maps, forecast consolidation & account playbooks

On Tue, Aug 10, 2027 at 9:12 AM Olga Petrov wrote:
> Team —
>
> We need a tight QBR package for the board readout and the GTM leadership meeting. I’ve attached a starter workbook (runway-maps_v1.xlsx) ...

Quick pass from my side — attached a one-pager for Stratus (stratus_account_onepager.pdf) and a short CSV I pulled with current ARR pulls. Highlights:

- Stratus Retail — ARR: $460k, close target: 2027-09-08, confidence: 55% (mid).
  Blockers: SOC 2 evidence requested; procurement legal redlines (standard T&Cs).
  Playbook: 1) Share SOC evidence pack (Marissa) 2) Procurement call with Delta Systems (Mar 3) 3) Exec intro + finalize EULA (Olga).

- NimblePay — ARR: $210k, close: 2027-08-30, confidence: 70% (high).
  Blockers: Billing integration test scheduled; engineering POC 8/19.

- Sentinel Health — ARR: $120k, close: 2027-10-15, confidence: 40% (low).
  Blockers: data residency questions and private deployment cost estimates.

I’ve marked the items I can own in the workbook. I’ll upload the stratus one-pager to the drive and attach it here.

Attachments: stratus_account_onepager.pdf

-Marissa
Account Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-12T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR Prep — runway maps, forecast consolidation & account playbooks

On Wed, Aug 11, 2027 at 10:03 AM Marissa Cole wrote:
> Quick pass from my side — attached a one-pager for Stratus ...

Thanks — I pulled Marissa’s notes into the forecasting model. A few methodology notes so the consolidated sheet is auditable:

1) Confidence mapping: low=0.25, med=0.55, high=0.80 (applied to weighted ARR).
2) Close date normalization: if no firm date, I’m defaulting to the last day of the quarter for runway projections.
3) I added a margin for procurement lag (15 days) where legal review is outstanding.

I uploaded my working notes: forecast_notes_karthik.md (Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c_runway). I’ll update the consolidated tab with the weighted forecast numbers tonight and flag any accounts where the weighted number moves more than $25k from the owners’ stated ARR.

One ask: can sales engineering confirm the NimblePay billing test status after 8/19 so I can lock that close date?

-Karthik
Director, Forecasting & Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR Prep — runway maps, forecast consolidation & account playbooks (final)

Team —

Thanks for the updates. I pulled everything together and attached the final consolidated runway: qbr_runway_consolidated_20270814.xlsx. Summary items below (high level):

- Consolidated weighted ARR for prioritized accounts: $1.05M (weighted). Unweighted pipeline = $1.9M.
- Top risk: Stratus Retail (SOC pack + procurement EULA). Weighted contribution: $253k.
- Move to block: NimblePay is green; engineering POC confirmed, billing test scheduled.

Action items (owner):
- Marissa: send SOC evidence pack and schedule procurement call with Delta Systems (target: 2027-08-17).
- Karthik: finalize weighted numbers and push to the HubSpot deal (DEAL-8921).
- Tessa: finalize the 1-page exec summary for the leadership packet; I’ll include in the board appendix.
- Sean: please queue the Stratus call for the week of 8/23 and confirm attendee list.

External next step: I’ll reach out to Jamie Lee at Stratus (jamie.lee@stratusretail.com) tomorrow to confirm the SOC path and firm up a procurement date. Marissa — loop procurement@deltasys.com on that thread once we have dates.

Attachments: qbr_runway_consolidated_20270814.xlsx
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/87234 (DEAL-8921)

If no objections, I’ll consider this the locked runway and will push the final packet up to leadership Monday morning. Please reply here with any objections or last-minute deltas.

Olga Petrov
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
